caption: Figure 5. Bagpipe setup: All the components of Bagpipe can be individually scaled. The dashed arrows signify async RPCs while solid ones signify sync RPCs.
subject: how Bagpipe's four pipeline stages (data processors, oracle cachers, trainers, embedding servers) each scale independently via full RPC connectivity

groups.why_chosen: A four-stage pipeline anatomy where every stage is an identical '1...N' box pair with fully crossing connections to the next stage, illustrating independent, elastic per-stage scaling.
groups.what_to_learn: Give every stage an identical '1...N' box pair and fully cross-connect neighboring stages so any replica can reach any replica — but the dashed-vs-solid arrow meaning (async vs sync RPC) is explained only in the caption, never on the figure.
